feeds.title: Ariana Strings Blog
feeds.description: Ariana Strings brings a world-class team of musicians who have performed in over 80 weddings per year together providing high quality, musical experience for all couples by bringing the concert stage to their wedding day. In the blogs, you can find wedding music planning tips for all ceremonies, cocktail hours, and more!

feeds.title: Hartford Jazz Society Blog
feeds.description: The blog covers articles on concert reviews, jazz history, Hartford Jazz society news, album reviews, and more. The mission of The Hartford Jazz Society is to cultivate an appreciation of the sound, culture, and love of jazz by presenting a variety of live events and other activities. We strive to accomplish these goals through offering jazz-related performances, activities, education, and support throughout the Greater Hartford community.
